summary: Integrate AI Test Harness with Jira (summary field truncated in Jira, see Q-AI-1)
tagging: pytest parametrize id 'IDS-3 AC-n' on every test in tests/ids3/

acs.text: The harness retrieves a real Jira story using its issue key.

checks.description: local adapter returns IDS-3 by key; malformed key rejected; cloud adapter GETs /rest/api/2/issue/IDS-3 with Basic auth; unknown key → error
expected_evidence: junit: harness · request path and auth header seen by REST stand-in

checks.description: LIVE: cloud adapter pulls IDS-3 from intentdrivenengineering.atlassian.net (skipped unless JIRA_* set)
expected_evidence: junit: harness (skip reason recorded when no credentials)

acs.text: Story descriptions and acceptance criteria are extracted correctly.

checks.description: 8 criteria extracted from the real Description, texts exact; description kept verbatim; same from REST v2 wiki markup

acs.text: Missing acceptance criteria prevent test execution.

checks.description: Gate 1 flags NO_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA; plan --check fails with zero ACs; run refuses to execute suites with zero ACs
expected_evidence: junit: harness · exit code and suite-ran marker

acs.text: Test plans map test cases to acceptance criteria.

checks.description: IDS-3 plan lists AC-1..AC-8 and validates; tagged test names map to ACs; documented pytest classname tag recognised

acs.text: Jira integration tests produce deterministic results.

checks.description: same snapshot → identical ACs and Gate 1 questions; same REST response → identical normalised issue

acs.text: Verification reports distinguish passed, failed, skipped, and blocked tests.

checks.description: JUnit pass/fail/skip/error classified; guardrail breach → BLOCKED suite; report lists all four outcomes

acs.text: Authorized verification results can be posted to Jira.

checks.description: local adapter appends comment; cloud adapter POSTs to /rest/api/2/issue/IDS-3/comment; approve without --by refused
expected_evidence: junit: harness · POST path and body seen by REST stand-in · live MCP comment ID once authorised

checks.description: SHOP-142 simulated story still yields its committed criteria; existing engine unit suite passes
